findings.description: Direct inspection of the eleven V146 renders shows the thigh-surface placement on the front-lap panels does not resolve posed skirt behavior. Crouch and sit still expose large areas of the shorts/upper thighs as the main overskirt shell holds a rearward, rigid shape; prone still lifts the skirt into a broad sheet. Reject the pose coverage and deformation.

Neutral front/back and three-quarter views remain a broad, near-conical skirt with weakly legible panel pleats and a hard, uneven hem. Side views show a wedge-like shell and visible separated lap/fold layers; the front-lap thigh placement did not create a continuous drape or controlled silhouette.

The horizontal shelf at the waist-to-hip join and angular triangular artifacts along both torso sides remain visible in front, side, three-quarter, and posed views. These defects are independent of the front-lap placement and still block appearance acceptance.

nextAction: Keep candidate REJECTED and prototype-only. V146's front-lap placement fails to keep a coherent skirt silhouette through crouch, sit, and prone; neutral pleats remain obscured by the broad shell, and the waist/hip/torso discontinuities persist. Stop reusing local front-lap-to-thigh projection. Revise the sewn overskirt as a pose-compatible panel assembly with separate articulated front coverage and a controlled shared hem, and repair the waist/hip/torso joins before another 11-view review. Fit, weights, UV, Unity, VRChat, and release remain independent gates.
